name: pulsar-strudel
description: Live code Strudel patterns from within Pulsar

scripts.build: esbuild lib/strudel-entry.mjs --bundle --format=iife --global-name=strudel --define:import.meta.url=__strudelBundleUrl --banner:js="var __strudelBundleUrl = document.currentScript.src;" --outfile=lib/strudel.bundle.js && mkdir -p lib/assets && cp node_modules/@strudel/core/dist/assets/clockworker-*.js lib/assets/
